title: Full Grown Woman Throws Temper Tantrum with Police
description:
On July 5, 2021, police received a call after someone heard yelling originating from a nearby apartment in Bangor, WI. A male was upset with his girlfriend and asked her to leave multiple times but she would not, yelled loudly, and called him obscenities. She does not pay rent or hold any other form of residency at the address. In the end, she was arrested for disorderly conduct and threats to a law enforcement officer. She is free on a signature bond.
